review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: About the Role We're looking for a hands-on IT specialist to own our office IT: keeping our network secure, our internet fast and stable, and our team's laptops running smoothly. Location: New Cairo – On-site, with remote support when needed What You'll Do Firewall & Network Security Configure, manage, and monitor the company firewall (rules, access policies, VPN) Keep firewall firmware and security policies up to date Monitor for suspicious traffic and respond to security incidents Secure our Wi-Fi with separate guest and staff networks and strong access controls Internet & Network Performance Keep internet across the office stable and fast Monitor bandwidth usage and resolve slowdowns or outages Work with our ISP on issues, upgrades, and backup connections Maintain routers, switches, and access points, and keep an up-to-date network diagram Employee Laptops Set up laptops for new hires
